rules.source: Approved Final10 Version2 sections2/9/14, exact final images05/06/10. User authorized implementation, original Codex Review and serial merges. Current source has original P01 time repair and all prior merged changes. No deployment or real business-data operation.
rules.rule: Read effective current customer PO dates and quantities using the original cumulative receiving/packing group. Clamp and reconcile each PO before aggregation, preserve unknown and current lifecycle scope.
rules.initialization: No new ledger or migration. Read current PO sizes, original dated changes, original effective cumulative packing and frozen reminder offset in bounded batches after requested year/month date-or-undated predicates, with history limited to selected PO IDs. Business-number field keeps original sourcing permission, filters actual UUID placeholders and does not invent IDs. Unknown source remains nullable.
rules.dateAndPermission: Shanghai observation date determines overdue independently from selected day. Current customer date is distinct from factory date, historical original date and actual shipping occurrence. No inferred past daily shipment/arrival. Authorization precedes quantities; cancelled/special-closed demand stays a separate range.
rules.expectation: Real native PG and pure projection tests reconcile complete authorized year/month/day against current PO quantities, partial/zero/corrected/extra packing, two dates, multi-factory and full transfer with old allocation zero. Current due change enters only its effective new year, original history stays traceable. Known-demand and comparable known-quantity sets remain distinct.

rules.source: Approved Final10 Version2 sections2/9/14, exact final images05/06/10. User authorized implementation, original Codex Review and serial merges. Current source has original P01 time repair and all prior merged changes. No deployment or real business-data operation.
rules.rule: Use an authorized, coherent lightweight read snapshot for aggregates and paged PO rows. Normal refresh reads current facts; only explicit older query identifiers reuse labelled older observations with live role/object/field revalidation.
rules.initialization: Reuse original bounded actor-owned PostgreSQL AnalysisResultStore; generic type has no runtime change to old statistics. Full summaries use lightweight facts rather than per-order Journey/SLA. Existing clock and exception authorization helpers retained. Explicit bound rejects oversized queries instead of truncating.
rules.dateAndPermission: Actual AuthService and active roles are revalidated before reads and snapshot reuse; original direct technical grants are evaluated together, original assigned task/preparation/QC exceptions retain canonical policy. No cross-user query reuse, no private fields through removed capability. Scenario/revision changes reject old query; refresh has no old snapshot identifier. Explicit range coverage permits contained year-to-month reuse but rejects widening and cross-day reuse; a day and its own groups retain their original observation.
rules.expectation: Native authenticated 20-PO five-mother primary-owner scope verifies no per-order canonical-policy calls for the original direct grant, then same valid session loses old query and reads no objects after role removal. Original warehouse assignment still invokes original exception policy and reads its two PO facts. Real scenario midnight isolates ordinary/scenario scope; packed corrections appear on next fresh read while explicit old query is labelled. Guarded synthetic volume5010 unrelated-year PO plus an undated PO does not trigger the small-month cap; the genuinely oversized requested year still409, and narrow monthly results cannot impersonate a complete year.

rules.source: Approved Final10 Version2 sections2/9/14, exact final images05/06/10. User authorized implementation, original Codex Review and serial merges. Current source has original P01 time repair and all prior merged changes. No deployment or real business-data operation.
rules.rule: Expose four authenticated read-only calendar resources through the original digital-production route registration and canonical test mapping, with finite correctness budgets and unchanged business commands.
rules.initialization: Only year/month/day/missing GET resources are added under original configured digital-production service. Strict date/year/month/page/search inputs reject invalid values. New PG suite joins original LONG_CORRECTNESS and risk mapping. Original source time inventory preserves existing annotations.
rules.dateAndPermission: PMC remains read only, invalid dates and foreign query identifiers are rejected. No date edit/approval, upload, shipment, history rewrite or deployment route added. Correctness timeout remains original configured100 seconds, independent from business SLA. Existing isolated fixture cleanup remains exact.
rules.expectation: Target native PG, domain unit, API build/lint and actual canonical preflight/secret checks pass on this actual merged base and exact source. No synthetic browser page is claimed: the three user-facing calendar views belong to subsequent P07, with final representative integration validation later.
